description: Used for permissions that are associated with activity recognition.
Used for runtime permissions related to user's calendar.
Used for runtime permissions associated with accessing and modifying the device's call history.
Used for permissions that are associated with accessing camera or capturing images/video from the device.
Used for permissions related to contacts, accounts, and personal user profiles on this device.
Used for permissions that allow accessing the device location.
Used for permissions that are associated with accessing microphone audio from the device.

Bundles all permissions required for discovering, connecting, communicating, or enforcing policies with physical hardware or devices in the immediate vicinity via Bluetooth, Wi-Fi Direct, UWB, NFC, or nearby streaming.
Used for permissions that are associated with posting notifications
Used for permissions associated with active telephony features, call management, emergency cell broadcasts, and cellular state routing.
Required to be able to read audio files from shared storage.
Required to be able to read image and video files from shared storage.
Used for permissions that are associated with accessing body or environmental sensors, as well as spatial, head, face, eye, and hand tracking.
Used for permissions related to user's SMS messages.
Used for runtime permissions related to the shared external storage.
Used for permissions handling IP-based data transport, global internet routing, Wi-Fi/Ethernet interface states, and local network socket communication.
Used for permissions that allow regular applications to launch specialized foreground services (e.g., for data synchronization, media playback, sensor tracking, or file management).
Used for permissions related to setting up, managing, observing presence, and interacting with companion hardware like smartwatches or smart glasses.

Used for permissions associated with controlling the application lifecycle, managing package installation states, scheduling background tasks, retrieving task states, and adjusting system resource optimization.

Used for low-risk permissions that modify system-level interface elements (like wallpapers, status bars, window overlays, PiP, exact alarms) or control basic hardware peripherals (like flashlight), display rendering settings (like picture profiles), and audio/vibration policies.

Used for non-dangerous permissions interacting with system security integrations, credential management, biometric authentication, device protection modes, and application integrity protections against screen capturing.
Used for permissions that manage background data synchronization parameters, account sync statistics, account authentication, and account credentials management.
Used for highly sensitive UI capabilities that monitor screen content, read assist structures, manage user input dictionaries, or intercept low-level hardware inputs.
Used for permissions related to reading and writing the user's social stream updates.
Used for permissions related to reading and modifying subscribed content feeds.
